name: tva_rounding_once_per_rate
rule: docs/features.md, fiscal rules: rounding to the centime, half away from zero, once per rate group. Rates are basis points (1900 = 19 %). Amounts are integer centimes. Expected values are written by hand, never computed.

pct_cases.name: exact half rounds away from zero: 19 % of 2,50 DA = 0,475
exact half on a negative amount rounds away from zero: 19 % of -2,50 DA = -0,475
50 % of an odd centime: 0,005 rounds up

overflow_cases.name: i64::MAX times 19 % overflows the intermediate product
